== Valentine's Day Event (Quest 1) ==
#In [[Moscovia]], talk to '''Pinkamenia''' {{navi|mosc_in|21|246}} in the tool shop {{navi|moscovia|222|176}} and help her.
#She will tell you to bring a +8 {{item|id=5024 Cake Hat}} to the Baker Extraordinaire next to her so that you can hunt the {{item|id=7864 Stolen Cacao}}.
#Talk to Baker Extraordinaire to get the {{item|id=5105 Cake Hat (Costume Version)}}.
##Note that having a Cake Hat (Costume Version) is entirely optional, provided you can get the Stolen Cacao required.
#Hunt 15 {{item|id=7864 Stolen Cacao}} while wearing the {{item|id=5105 Cake Hat (Costume Version)}} (or purchase it from other players) and return back to Pinkamenia.
#She will reward you with:
#* 500,000 [[Base EXP]] (750,000 if [[VIP]])
#* 400,000 [[Job EXP]] (600,000 if [[VIP]])
#* 1 {{item|id=617 Old Purple Box}}
#* 2 {{item|id=12319 Rune Strawberry Cake}}

== Cacao Rewards ==
After completing the quest you will have the option to trade in {{item|id=7864 Stolen Cacao}} for the following:

* &nbsp;&nbsp;1 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=538 Well-baked Cookie}}
* &nbsp;&nbsp;2 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=558 Chocolate}}
* &nbsp;&nbsp;5 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=539 	Piece of Cake}}
* 10 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=573 Chocolate Drink}}, a {{item|id=559 Hand-made Chocolate}}, a {{item|id=560 Handmade White Chocolate}} or a {{item|id=12130 Cookie Bag}}
* 15 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=12062 Chocolate Mousse Cake}}, a {{item|id=596 Cute Strawberry-Choco}} or a {{item|id=597 	Lovely Choco-Tart}}
* 20 Stolen Cacao for a {{item|id=12414 Guarana Candy}} or a {{item|id=12319 Rune Strawberry Cake}}
